recall.minute: Prompts combine role, instruction, context, examples and output format; missing parts force guesses. Zero-shot (instruction only) vs few-shot (k examples); in-context learning infers the task without weight updates; balance, order and representativeness matter; returns diminish while tokens grow. Instructions: specify audience, length, tone, constraints and success criteria; instructions before delimited data; allow 'I don't know'. Self-consistency: sample n answers at T > 0, majority vote; P_maj = Σ_{k>n/2} C(n,k)p^k(1−p)^(n−k): p = 0.6 → 0.68 (n = 5), 0.83 (n = 21); needs p > 0.5; cost × n; 42, 42, 7, 42 → 42. APE: generate and score candidate instructions. Chaining: extract → filter → summarise; inspectable but more calls. Function calling: schema-described tools, model emits JSON call, app validates (reject missing args), executes, returns result. Constrained decoding: mask invalid tokens ("42" not "forty"): guarantees format, not truth.
